name: aria-helpfulness
description: Evaluates how effectively ARIA's response helps the customer progress toward their goal.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Directly and fully answers the customer's need with clear, actionable information.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Helpful with minor omissions or one unnecessary caveat.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Partially helpful; answers some of the need but leaves key questions unanswered.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Mostly unhelpful; heavy hedging, deflection, or misunderstands the customer's need.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely unhelpful — refuses, deflects, or provides irrelevant information.
